initialization: from_scratch; common B0 parameter initialization and seed
analysis: same sealed medium population plus a separate fixed-panel training probe

schedule_semantics.lr: unchanged endpoint warmup cosine, warmup_fraction=0.16, over two epochs
schedule_semantics.ema: unchanged cosine 0.99 to 1.0 over two epochs
schedule_semantics.comparison: both arms share the shorter relative schedule; historical epoch2 is not this anchor

fixed_panel_diagnostics.panel: one fixed allowed training-expression panel shared by all arms and conditions
fixed_panel_diagnostics.identity: reuse sealed medium condition/row identities where eligible; seal the extra probe separately
fixed_panel_diagnostics.independence: deduplicate controls; report actual valid counts; do not replace missing rows silently
fixed_panel_diagnostics.stages: Response injection input, branch and actual state; self/cross/FFN; final norm

research_iteration.future_rounds: adaptive after deep analysis; four rounds are a review, not automatic success
research_iteration.success: joint representation separation and response utility; not CE or DINO rank alone
research_iteration.continuation: until task-relevant representation problem is resolved
research_iteration.repeated_candidate: R3-RI exactly repeats the unchanged two-epoch RI configuration
research_iteration.hypothesis: same-input alignment and compatible-context dispersion improve response representation without setting target rank or cosine margins

source_roles.training_commit: bound separately by the native clean published queue and launch source_commit

alignment_uniformity.representation: two Student Global Response CLS after final RMSNorm before projector
alignment_uniformity.normalization: auxiliary FP32 L2 only; main representations unchanged
alignment_uniformity.alignment: mean(1-cos) for the same control and perturbation across two Globals
alignment_uniformity.uniformity: logmeanexp(4*(cos-1)) across eligible unordered pairs separately per Global, then mean
alignment_uniformity.eligible_pairs: same control cell_type::batch context and different perturbation
alignment_uniformity.population: complete differentiable cross-rank and accumulation population; deduplicate(control,p) before sharding
alignment_uniformity.partial_diagnostics: AU unavailable; never fake a full-population loss
